{{recipe}}

Tender filet mignon crusted with a blend of spices and seared in a cast iron pan.

== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (24–32 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) [[Cookbook:Beef#Loin|filet mignons]], 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] thick
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tsp freshly ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] smoked [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
* 1 tbsp ground [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Dijon Mustard|Dijon mustard]]
* 2 tsp dried [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]
* 1 tbsp dried [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Cognac|cognac]]

== Procedure ==
#Heat a 10-inch [[Cookbook:Cast Iron|cast iron]] [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] over high heat for 7–10 minutes. 
#Meanwhile, [[Cookbook:Brush|brush]] steaks with Dijon mustard. Combine seasonings and press into meat. Brush with olive oil.
#Place steaks in pan and cook 2 minutes per side. Insert a probe [[Cookbook:Thermometer|thermometer]] into one of the steaks.
#Place the pan in a 375°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] and cook until internal temperature reaches 140°F.
#Remove steaks from pan and keep warm.
#Heat pan over high heat 4 minutes. Turn off the heat and add the cognac. If the pan is hot enough, the alcohol will ignite by itself. If not, carefully light with a long match or firestick. Shake pan until flames die.
#Once flames die, return pan to high heat. [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] until reduced by half.
#Drizzle over steaks and serve warm.

steps.text: Heat a 10-inch cast iron skillet over high heat for 7–10 minutes.
Meanwhile, brush steaks with Dijon mustard. Combine seasonings and press into meat. Brush with olive oil.
Place steaks in pan and cook 2 minutes per side. Insert a probe thermometer into one of the steaks.
Place the pan in a 375°F oven and cook until internal temperature reaches 140°F.
Remove steaks from pan and keep warm.

Heat pan over high heat 4 minutes. Turn off the heat and add the cognac. If the pan is hot enough, the alcohol will ignite by itself. If not, carefully light with a long match or firestick. Shake pan until flames die.
Once flames die, return pan to high heat. Boil until reduced by half.
Drizzle over steaks and serve warm.
